tables.description: Records of individual product sales transactions.

columns.name: sale_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for each sale

columns.name: region
columns.description: Geographic region where the sale occurred (e.g. North, South, East, West)

columns.name: product_id
columns.description: Foreign key referencing the products table

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Total monetary value of the sale in USD

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Number of units sold

columns.name: sale_date
columns.description: Date and time the sale was recorded

columns.name: channel
columns.description: Sales channel (online, in-store, partner)

tables.description: Product catalogue with pricing and category information.

columns.name: product_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for each product

columns.name: name
columns.description: Human-readable product name

columns.name: category
columns.description: Product category (e.g. Electronics, Clothing, Food)

columns.name: unit_price
columns.description: Standard retail price per unit in USD

columns.name: cost_price
columns.description: Internal cost price per unit in USD

columns.name: is_active
columns.description: Whether the product is currently available for sale

tables.description: Registered customer accounts and their demographic data.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for each customer

columns.name: name
columns.description: Full name of the customer

columns.name: email
columns.description: Customer email address (unique)

columns.name: region
columns.description: Geographic region of the customer

columns.name: segment
columns.description: Customer segment (enterprise, SMB, individual)

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the customer account was created

tables.description: Purchase orders linking customers to one or more sales line items.

columns.name: order_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for each order

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Foreign key referencing the customers table

columns.name: order_date
columns.description: Date and time the order was placed

columns.name: status
columns.description: Current order status (pending, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled)

columns.name: total_amount
columns.description: Sum of all line item amounts for the order in USD
